description_en: Queries a list of services that are deployed in the dedicated resource group
description_zh: 列举专属资源组中已部署的服务列表
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-resource-services --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id iot --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceServices

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the resource group belongs
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about how to query the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。资源组ID，如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 服务列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的服务数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size
